prop_desc: Eight Texas constitutional amendments on the 1934 ballot — editorial 'The Eight Amendments' discussing each (taxation, salary changes, etc.)
notes_endorse: Editorial 'The Eight Amendments' discusses each amendment; print very small, individual positions difficult to distinguish

prop_desc: Amendment to remove absolute power of pardon and parole from the governor's hands and vest it in a non-political board of pardons and paroles
